2607.15545.title: CoWeaver: A Bi-directional, Learnable and Explainable Matching Engine for Mixed Human-Agent Science Collaboration
2607.15545.paper_summary: LLM-based agents excel at writing articles, coding and information retrieval. However, they fail to form strong collaborations within the scientific community due to the bidirectional, dynamic nature of the problem and a high demand of decision interpretability. We proposed COWEAVER, a bidirectional, learnable and explainable algorithm to match scientists and form strong collaborations within a human-agent network. COWEAVER matches candidates and requesters through filling capability gaps and filters candidates through a two-stage ranking step. Finally, the model explores newcomers by maintaining uncertainty-aware capability estimates and updating them through requester's feedback. We show that the selection mechanism of combining both exploration (UCB) and greedy of COWEAVER exceeds the greedy-only mechanism - the analytical best solution - on 6 out of the 20 tasks and performed on par with the greedy-only mechanism in terms of selecting the best candidate. We compared COWEAVER baselines in terms of matching quality and efficiency. COWEAVER outperforms baselines on all metrics.
2607.15545.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理在撰寫文章、編碼和信息檢索方面表現出色。<lb/>然而，由於問題的雙向動態性和對決策可解釋性的高需求，它們無法在科學社群中形成強有力的合作。<lb/>我們提出了 COWEAVER，一種雙向、可學習且可解釋的算法，用於匹配科學家並在人工代理網絡中形成強有力的合作。<lb/>COWEAVER 通過填補能力差距來匹配候選人和請求者，並通過兩階段排名步驟過濾候選人。<lb/>最後，該模型通過保持不確定性感知的能力估計並通過請求者的反饋進行更新來探索新來者。<lb/>我們展示了 COWEAVER 的選擇機制結合了探索 (UCB) 和貪婪，超過了僅貪婪機制 - 分析最佳解決方案 - 在 20 個任務中的 6 個上表現更佳，並在選擇最佳候選人方面與僅貪婪機制表現相當。<lb/>我們比較了 COWEAVER 的基準，在匹配質量和效率方面。<lb/>COWEAVER 在所有指標上均超越了基準。
